newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian shares close almost unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Italian shares close almost unchanged.

text.p: Italian shares closed almost unchanged on Thursday after dipping and then recovering on a warning by US federal reserve chairman Alan Greenspan that interest rates are set to rise for the first time in two years.
The all-share mibtel index was 0.06 higher at 11,731 at the close while the blue chip mib30 index finished 0.12 percent lower at 17,323.

Brokers said that despite the negative sentiment generated by the Greenspan comments, the Milan bourse appeared to have held up better than most European stock exchanges which took a battering after Wall Street's downturn.
Olivetti closed 2.2 percent higher at 613 lire with Snia and Burgo also ending the sessions substantially higher.
Telecom Italia and Stet stabilised after falling in previous sessions, closing 0.87 percent and 1.15 percent higher at 4,160 lire and 7,305 lire respectively.
TIM, which put on big gains on Tuesday and Wednesday after a positive analysts' presentation at the beginning of the week, closed 1.24 percent down at 4,630 lire on profit-taking.
Cars group Fiat was 2.48 percent down at 5,185 lire.
